body:
PhotonTransformerID/Run3_2024_v1/model.pt: TorchScript model of the transformer photon ID (ECAL crystals, preshower strips, PF candidates), read by RecoEgamma/PhotonIdentification PhotonTransformerIDProducer. 

PhotonTransformerID/Run3_2024_v1/preprocessing.json: standardisation constants and input conventions of the model.
title: Add the transformer photon ID model (Run 3, 2024 training)
